p: court of the LORD'S house: That is, in that place of the temple to which the people resort out of all Judah to sacrifice.
To the intent that they should pretend no ignorance, as in Ac 20:27.
repent of the evil: See Geneva "Jer 7:12"
a curse to all the nations: So that when they would curse any, they will say, "God do to you as to Jerusalem."

This house shall be like Shiloh: Because of God's promises to the temple, Ps 132:14 that he would forever remain there, hypocrites thought this temple could never perish and therefore thought it blasphemy to speak against it, Mt 26:61, Ac 6:13 not considering that this was meant of the Church where God will remain forever.
new gate of the LORD'S house: So called, because it was repaired by Jotham, 2Ki 15:35.

sent me to prophesy against this: He both shows the cause of his doings plainly and also threatens them that nothing would help, though they should put him to death, but heap greater vengeance on their heads.

house as the high places of: That is, of the House of the Lord, that is, Zion, and these examples the godly alleged to deliver Jeremiah out of the priests hands, whose rage else would not have been satisfied but by his death.
evil which he had pronounced against: So that the city was not destroyed, but by a miracle was delivered out of the hands of Sennacherib.

sent men into Egypt: Here is declared the fury of tyrants who cannot stand to hear God's word declared but persecute the ministers of it, and yet in the end they prevail nothing but provoke God' judgments so much more.
cast his dead body into the: As in the first Hezekiah's example is to be followed, so in this other Jehoiakim's act it to be abhorred: for God's plague descended on him and his household.
the son of Shaphan was with: Which declares that nothing could have appeased their fury if God had not moved this noble man to stand valiantly in his defense.
